# 1C BSL AI Copilot: Full Technical Specification

## Technical Architecture
- Language: TypeScript 5.3+ targeting Node 18+ / VS Code Extension API 1.85+.
- Build Pipeline: esbuild bundle -> OPC VSIX archive packager.
- Transport: HTTPS streaming to https://api.normahub.cc/v1/chat/completions.
- Key Vault: Native VS Code SecretStorage API (OS Keychain / Secret Service).

## Supported Language Identifiers
- bsl (1C:Enterprise Business Server Language)
- 1c
- oscript (OneScript)

## Rules & Standards Enforced
- ITS-PERF-001: Prohibition of query execution inside iteration loops.
- ITS-PERF-002: Mandatory parameterization of virtual tables in accumulation and information registers.
- ITS-LOCK-001: Mandatory explicit DataLock (БлокировкаДанных) in document posting handlers.
- ITS-UI-003: Deprecation of synchronous modal alerts in web-client compatible modules.

## Authentication
- Environment: NORMAHUB_API_KEY
- SecretStorage: normahub1c.apiKey
- Gateway Base: https://api.normahub.cc/v1
